ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  ACME Solar Holdings Limited (ASHL), through its subsidiary, has successfully commissioned an additional 17.91 MW/74.323 MWh of Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) capacity, bringing its cumulative operational BESS capacity to 71.640 MW/297.292 MWh with a Commercial Operation Date (COD) of October 25, 2026. This represents positive project execution and materially enhances the company's energy storage capabilities and future revenue generation potential from the larger FDRE Project, with no apparent red flags.
